sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only). [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Stagnation Collapse (decreases Unison gauge gains by 2, reduces action speed by 30, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, and decreases all stats by 40%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Lowers the effect of Unison gauge reduction by 25% when equipped in the main slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Water and Star Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Mighty Hound Strike] Yu Inumaru or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
